# Eric Stafford for Arizona Senate

> Eric Stafford is the Democratic nominee for Arizona State Senate in Legislative District 29 (LD29), running against Republican incumbent Sen. Janae Shamp in the general election on November 3, 2026. LD29 is a West Valley district in Maricopa County that covers parts of Surprise, El Mirage, Glendale, Goodyear, Litchfield Park and Peoria, plus Wittmann and Morristown. Eric is a lifelong Arizonan from Goodyear and a tradesman: a certified A&P (airframe and powerplant) aircraft mechanic and a machinist, who has also worked as a veterinary technician. He is a Clean Elections candidate who takes no corporate PAC or dark money.

This is the official campaign website: https://stafford4az.com/

## About Eric

- [About Eric Stafford](https://stafford4az.com/about/): biography, background in the trades, why he is running, and answers to common questions about Eric and the race
- [Platform](https://stafford4az.com/platform/): full positions on housing, workers' rights, education, healthcare, infrastructure and growth, small business, climate, veterans, immigration, reproductive freedom, public health, and campaign finance reform
- [Endorsements](https://stafford4az.com/endorsements/): organizations and people supporting the campaign
- [Transparency](https://stafford4az.com/transparency/): Clean Elections status and public campaign finance filings
